'''Game News & Updates''' in ''[[The Duelist]]'' #28 (August 1998, page 70) by [[Cory Herndon]] records unlimited [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]], [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] and [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]] printings plus the [[Second Anthology]].<ref name="duelist28news" />

[[File:Duelist 28 page 70.jpg|thumb|right|260px|The Duelist #28, August 1998, page 70.]]

The SWCCG item sits among other Decipher and licensed-game notices on the same page.

<blockquote>
'''Star Wars CCG''' (Decipher): Unlimited (white border) editions of the sold-out ''A New Hope'', ''Hoth'', and ''Dagobah'' expansions should now be available. The ''Second Anthology'' will include eight unlimited ''Premiere'', two ''Dagobah'', and two ''Cloud City'' boosters as well as six "preview cards"—the Mon Calamari Cruiser, rebel leader Mon Mothma, and Flagship Operations for the light side, and Thunderflare, Rapid Deployment, and the Sarlaac for the dark side. The ''Special Edition'' expansion will draw on the new images and characters introduced in last year's re-release of the ''Star Wars'' trilogy. Look for it to be sold in both starters and boosters in September. Decipher will sponsor a nationwide tournament weekend in late August dedicated to SW:CCG fan Shawn Valdez, who died of cancer in 1996 at age 13. Proceeds will benefit a children's cancer fund in Valdez's hometown, Jacksonville, Florida (a card in the ''Hoth'' expansion commemorates Valdez). &lt;CCGCustomerService@decipher.com&gt;; &lt;<nowiki>www.decipher.com</nowiki>&gt;
</blockquote>
